data.exact_reserve_text: During the current period, the Syndicate entered into a transaction to reinsure certain prior year claims liabilities. The transaction had a positive impact on the reported profit for the financial year. The cost of the retrospective reinsurance arrangement entered in the year has reduced the reported net earned premium. The associated additional reinsurance recoveries have reduced the reported net claims incurred. This accounting treatment has reduced the reported net claims ratio of 50.9% for the year (2022 61.2%). Absent the retrospective reinsurance arrangement, reserve strengthening was required on the older years (2021 and prior) within the International Liability portfolio.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year reserves showed a net gross strengthening of GBP 15.5m (approximately 1.14% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by adverse development on older liability years. However, a retrospective reinsurance transaction in the year materially increased reinsurance recoveries, producing a net release on a net-of-reinsurance basis. The prior-year movements primarily affected the International Liability/Casualty portfolio (notably 2021 and prior).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (15.5) is taken from the Technical Provisions roll-forward 'Claims expense - previous year' (gross) in note 12. Net movement was a release due to large reinsurers' share movement (-76.9) producing a net release of -61.4; both gross and net movements are presented in the notes. The claims development triangle is present and was used to cross-check but RITC and reinsurance transactions can distort comparisons. LOB mapping: regulatory segment shows 'Third party liability' and 'Reinsurance acceptances' - 'Third party liability' mapped to standard 'Casualty'.
